name: Slovakia
famous_for: High Tatras alpine peaks, Spiš Castle (one of central Europe's largest castle ruins), and over 6,000 natural karst caves.
tourists: Over 5.0M visitors; famous for Bojnice fairytale castle, Dobšinská Ice Cave, and Bratislava Old Town cobblestones.
must_know: Slovakia possesses the highest concentration of castles and fortified ruins per capita in the world, with over 180 castles and 425 châteaux.
fun_fact: Dobšinská Ice Cave in Slovak Paradise is an underground wonder where glacier ice fills colossal limestone caverns year-round.
